walkthroughs.body_html:
X ~ N(50, 4), Y ~ N(60, 9), independent. Find Y - X distribution.

Mean 60-50=10, Var = 9+4=13. So Y-X ~ N(10, 13).

mcqs.q: Can a definite integral give a negative value, even when integrating a function from left to right?
options: Yes — if the function is below the x-axis over the interval, the integral is negative.
£24.50, by multiplying £3.50 by 7.
Definite integrals are always positive because area cannot be negative.

mcqs.q: What is the sum of the interior angles of any pentagon?
options: 360 degrees, because all polygons' angles sum to one full turn.
180 degrees, the same as a triangle.

540 degrees — use (n - 2) x 180 with n = 5.
